environmental_entry_points: tools/generate_environment_audio.py delegates wind, foliage and shelter
processing: Per-channel DC removal, zero-phase high/low-pass filtering, two-second equal-power tail-to-head crossfades and joint gain to the previous RMS levels with a peak cap. Shelter uses a separate window-wind excerpt with a 450 Hz low-pass. No synthesis, pitch shifting, time stretching, reverb or artificial stereo widening. Stereo files are used as supplied; no assumed M/S matrix conversion.
